job.job_description:
Design and develop scalable AI architectures and systems to meet business needs.


Train and fine-tune models using TensorFlow, PyTorch, or other deep learning frameworks.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into production-grade applications.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and infrastructure for model deployment.


Work on cloud AI platforms such as AWS SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, or IBM WatsonX.


Implement hyperparameter tuning and experimentation to improve model performance.




Job Requirements




Strong expertise in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, and related technologies.


Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG frameworks, Hugging Face, LangChain, Vector Databases, Transformer & Diffusion Models (GPT, BERT, T5, Llama, Stable Diffusion).


Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.


Experience with distributed systems and cloud technologies.


Strong understanding of scalable AI architecture and system design principles.


Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a team environment.
